prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: The parent (c003) reverted CTS clustering to size=1/diameter=50 and gained mostly on TNS. The remaining large TNS after propagated-clock global routing comes from setup violations that rsz cannot fix because all *_upper BUF/CLKBUF cells are in DONT_USE_CELLS — so upper-tier critical logic has no repair buffers. Allowing the upper-tier clock/data buffers (by removing only the `*_upper` BUF/CLKBUF entries from DONT_USE_CELLS in the shared resize.tcl) gives rsz repair capacity on both tiers, which should reduce many moderate violations (TNS) without changing partition or routing topology, and should not increase overflow beyond the 300 cap because buffers are inserted only along failing paths.
Rule-based digest:
total=+0.229 robust(mean-std)=+0.052 min_case=+0.054 all_valid=True
  ariane133-ng45: score=+0.110 dWNS=+4.7% dTNS=+15.1% overflow~232
  bp-ng45: score=+0.065 dWNS=+2.6% dTNS=+8.7% overflow~182
  bp_fe-ng45: score=+0.054 dWNS=+3.9% dTNS=+6.3% overflow~217
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: The hypothesis held: all three cases improved, with TNS gains (6–15%) exceeding WNS gains (2.6–4.7%), consistent with rsz repairing many moderate upper-tier violations. Ariane133-ng45 moved most (dTNS +15.1%), and overflow stayed well under the 300 cap (~182–232), confirming buffers inserted only along failing paths without disturbing partition/routing. Next step: verify the DONT_USE edit is scoped to only `*_upper` BUF/CLKBUF entries (no lower-tier or non-buffer cells removed) and re-run across more seeds to confirm robustness.
